records.jp: 花火ってさ……すっごいおいしそうだよね
records.en_original: Don't fireworks look yummy?
records.en: Don't fireworks look yummy?

records.jp: う、うんそうだね
records.en_original: Y-yeah, sure.
records.en: Y-yeah, sure.

records.jp: …………愛央ちゃん、本当にそう思ってる？
records.en_original: Ao... Do you really think so?
records.en: Ao-chan... Do you really think so?

records.jp: お、思ってる思ってる！
records.en_original: I do, I do!
records.en: I do, I do!

records.jp: じゃあ花火をおかずに、ご飯十杯は食べれる？
records.en_original: Then do you think you'd be able to eat 10 helpings of rice with fireworks?
records.en: Then do you think you'd be able to eat 10 helpings of rice with fireworks?

records.jp: もちろん食べれるよ！
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: ふっ、引っかかったね！　花火は甘味！<CR>一緒に食べるならご飯じゃなくてドーナツなのです！！
records.en_original: Ha! Got you! Fireworks are sweet! You don't eat them with rice, you eat them with donuts!
records.en: Ha! Got you! Fireworks are sweet! You don't eat them with rice, you eat them with donuts!

records.jp: そ、そうかな？
records.en_original: Y-you think so?
records.en: Y-you think so?

records.jp: じ～っとよく見てみて
records.en_original: Look really closely.
records.en: Look really closely.

records.jp: うむむむむ……
records.en_original: Hmmmm...
records.en: Hmmmm...

records.jp: 段々と花火が甘味に見えてこないかな？
records.en_original: Don't they start looking sweet if you look at them long enough?
records.en: Don't they start looking sweet if you look at them long enough?

records.jp: ごめん。やっぱ、うーん……
records.en_original: Sorry, I don't...
records.en: Sorry, I don't...

records.jp: む！　友達なんだから、<CR>言いたいことがあるならはっきり言ってほしいのです
records.en_original: Hmph! If you're really my friend I want you to be honest with me.
records.en: Hmph! If you're really my friend I want you to be honest with me.

records.jp: この鍋……どこから出てきたの？
records.en_original: Where did this pot come from...?
records.en: Where did this pot come from...?

records.jp: えっ、あっ、これはおやつ用に持って来てて……
records.en_original: Oh, uh, that? It's for holding my snacks...
records.en: Oh, uh, that? It's for holding my snacks...

records.jp: お、おやつ……！？　鍋が……！？
records.en_original: S-snacks? This?!
records.en: S-snacks? This?!

records.jp: こころって、あんまり太ったりしないの？
records.en_original: Do you just not gain weight, Kokoro?
records.en: Do you just not gain weight, Kokoro?

records.jp: うーん、気にしたことないかも
records.en_original: Hmm, I've never really worried about it.
records.en: Hmm, I've never really worried about it.

records.jp: 気にしたこと、ない……！？<CR>そんな、これだけ食べて……？
records.en_original: You've never...worried about it?! Even though you eat so much?
records.en: You've never...worried about it?! Even though you eat so much?

records.jp: ま、まあ実際、お腹に<CR>余分なお肉がついてる感じはしないんだよなぁ……
records.en_original: W-well, it looks like you really don't have any extra flab or anything...
records.en: W-well, it looks like you really don't have any extra flab or anything...

records.jp: そ、そうかな？<CR>あ、でも一人だけで食べてるってのも良くないよね
records.en_original: Y-you think? Though I guess it's not good to eat all alone.
records.en: Y-you think? Though I guess it's not good to eat all alone.

records.jp: あ、じゃあそのたこ焼き一個貰ってもいい？
records.en_original: Ooh, can I have a takoyaki then?
records.en: Ooh, can I have a takoyaki then?

records.jp: ご、ごめん愛央ちゃん。よく聞こえなかったのです。<CR>なんて言ったのかな……？
records.en_original: S-sorry, Ao, I didn't hear you. What did you say?
records.en: S-sorry, Ao-chan, I didn't hear you. What did you say?

records.jp: え、あ……た、たこ焼き、一個欲しいなー……なんて
records.en_original: O-oh, uh... I kinda wanted a piece of takoyaki... If that's okay...
records.en: O-oh, uh... I kinda wanted a piece of takoyaki... If that's okay...

records.jp: ……も、もちろん……なので、す……<CR>き、きっとたこ焼きも……それを望んでいるのです……
records.en_original: O-of course... I'm sure the takoyaki would like that as well...
records.en: O-of course... I'm sure the takoyaki would like that as well...

records.jp: は、はいどうぞ……ッ
records.en_original: H-here...
records.en: H-here...

records.jp: じゃ、じゃあいただきまーす……
records.en_original: Th-thanks...
records.en: Th-thanks...

records.jp: 最後のたこ焼きファイナルたこ焼きラストオブたこ焼き<CR>なのですなのですなのですなのです……
records.en_original: My last takoyaki... My final takoyaki... The penultimate takoyaki...
records.en: My last takoyaki... My final takoyaki... The penultimate takoyaki...

records.jp: あ、あむっ
records.en_original: *Chomp*
records.en: *Chomp*

records.jp: ありがとうこころ。美味しかったよ
records.en_original: Thanks, Kokoro. That was good.
records.en: Thanks, Kokoro. That was good.

records.jp: なんで！？
records.en_original: Why?!
records.en: Why?!

records.jp: ふふっ……愛央ちゃんが美味しかったなら……<CR>よかっ、った……のです……
records.en_original: Hehe... As long as you enjoyed it... That's what...matters...
records.en: Hehe... If it tasted good to you, Ao-chan... then... that's good...

records.jp: こころ！？　こころおおおおおお！！
records.en_original: Kokoro?! Kokorooooo!
records.en: Kokoro?! Kokorooooo!

records.jp: ん、勇希がワッフル焼いたから食べにおいでって
records.en_original: Hm? Yuki says she made waffles and to come have some.
records.en: Hm? Yuki says she made waffles and to come have some.

records.jp: 何してるの愛央ちゃん！　早く行くよ！！
records.en_original: What are you doing, Ao? We have to hurry!
records.en: What are you doing, Ao-chan? We have to hurry!

records.jp: ……ウン
records.en_original: ...Right.
records.en: ...Right.

records.jp: ご、ごめんやっぱりいいや！<CR>ご飯食べたばっかりでお腹いっぱいだった！
records.en_original: S-sorry, I'm actually okay! I just ate so I'm not super hungry!
records.en: S-sorry, I'm actually okay! I just ate so I'm not super hungry!

records.jp: ほ、ほんとに……？　遠慮してない……？
records.en_original: R-really? Are you sure?
records.en: R-really? Are you sure?

records.jp: ぜ、ぜーんぜんしてない！
records.en_original: Y-yeah! Totally!
records.en: Y-yeah! Totally!

records.jp: それならしょうがないのです。<CR>じゃあこのたこ焼きはわたしが――
records.en_original: If you insist. Then I'll be having this last takoyaki—
records.en: If you insist. Then I'll be having this last takoyaki—

records.jp: おいひ～い！
records.en_original: So yummy!
records.en: So yummy!
